cmd:
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN= /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
D=/opt/trading-bot/classic
for f in classic_strategy classic_pullback3; do curl -sfH "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f.py" -o $D/$f.py; done
chown -R tbot:tbot $D
/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile $D/classic_strategy.py && echo COMPILED
cd $D; rm -f out_pb3_15m.txt; nohup sudo -u tbot /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python classic_pullback3.py 15m > out_pb3_15m.txt 2>&1 &
systemctl restart classicbot; sleep 6; systemctl is-active classicbot
